Ambient Lighting
The base layer of illumination — comfortable overall brightness from downlights, cove lighting and ceiling fixtures.
Accent Lighting
Spotlights, track lights, picture lights and wall grazers bring focus to artwork, textures and display shelves.
Decorative Lighting
Chandeliers, pendants, sconces and sculptural lamps add style and a statement feature to the interior.
Layered & Dimmable
Dimmers and layered schemes keep a room flexible, from bright and practical to soft and warm.
